test_cases.title: Successful Login with valid credentials
preconditions: The application is running and accessible
Valid test credentials are configured through environment variables
The Selenium WebDriver and required browser dependencies are configured
The user account is active and authorized to access the dashboard
steps: Navigate to the application login page
Verify the login form is displayed
Enter valid username and password retrieved from environment variables
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated successfully, redirected to the dashboard, dashboard title matches the expected value, welcome message is displayed with the expected text, and the login form is no longer visible
